airspeed.note: _airspeed(_pressure(raw)) m/s with _scale, _zero (Pa x 100) and _density; airspeed_cms = int(airspeed x 100), exact; dynamic_pressure, the Pa it came from. Plan B derives it from the floored Pa x 100, the port from raw / scale - zero / 100 in f32

cases.name: absent
cases.output: absent -- no ack at 0x25 (check wiring / bus id)

cases.name: garbage
cases.output: garbage -- acks at 0x25 but CRC fails (wrong device or bus noise)

cases.name: present
cases.output: present at 0x25 but setup rejected the frame (scale 240?)

diagnose.note: diagnose(): one frame read; the verdict text

frames.note: _frame_ok(frame) (length and all three CRCs); for 9 bytes the _signed16 words and the scale

pressure.note: _pressure(raw) with _scale = scale and _zero = zero: the tared dynamic pressure as the telemetry carries it (hundredths, Pa x 100, exact) and as the channel does (dynamic_pressure, Pa, signed: plan B floors to the hundredth, the port computes raw / scale - zero / 100 in f32)

run.note: run(): per pass the I2C transcript (the period wait left out: the owner schedules it) and its out: the telemetry row [dynamic_pressure Pa x 100, airspeed_cms, temperature x 100] (integers, exact) with the channel values pushed, dynamic_pressure Pa and airspeed m/s; or the fault (bus | checksum) and restart: null when no restart ran on that pass, true when it ran and plan B logged it, false when it ran and failed. _scale 60, _zero 0, _density 1.18

setup.note: setup() over a scripted part: input config, stored_zero (the NVS i32, null for none) and the I2C transcript; output ok, the latched scale, the zero (Pa x 100) and tared

tare.note: stateful; init sets _scale, _zero (Pa x 100), _density, _tared; actions pressure(raw) -> hundredths, update(properties) -> changed and the tare persisted (or the refusal text), calibration(channel Pa x 100 or null) -> prompt, calibrate() -> message (null on success) and the tare persisted; every out carries zero, tared and density after the step

out.refused: no reading yet -- wait for the first frame before taring

out.prompt: keep the pitot in STILL AIR -- do NOT blow into it, this captures the zero tare (now 0.00 Pa)
keep the pitot in STILL AIR -- do NOT blow into it, this captures the zero tare (now 12.34 Pa)
keep the pitot in STILL AIR -- do NOT blow into it, this captures the zero tare (now -1.25 Pa)
